ideas.idea: Add Disallow groups in robots.txt for other training crawlers (CCBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, ClaudeBot, etc.)
ideas.why: The config says trainingCrawlers: block but robots.txt only blocks GPTBot, so this brings the file in line with the declared policy.

ideas.idea: Add explicit Allow groups for AI search bots (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot, etc.) and repeat the /members/ Disallow
ideas.why: The wildcard group already allows these bots, so explicit groups change almost nothing.

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD structured data (Bakery/LocalBusiness, Product/Menu, Course/Event)
ideas.why: The deliberate choices say having no JSON-LD is not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add visible NAP (address, phone) and opening hours to the home page
ideas.why: The site has no address, phone or hours anywhere, and a local bakery needs these to be found and used.

ideas.idea: List every loaf on breads.html with ingredients, price and days available
ideas.why: The page claims over twenty loaves but names only two, so listing them gives readers and machines real content.

ideas.idea: Add dates, duration, price, group size and a booking link to classes.html
ideas.why: The page says 'Book early' but gives no way to book and no class details.

ideas.idea: Add a link or instructions for pre-ordering on the home page
ideas.why: The page mentions pre-order for weekend collection but gives no way to do it.

ideas.idea: Remove data-nosnippet from the allergen text and move allergen details into the main content
ideas.why: The data-nosnippet attribute is a deliberate, scoped choice and is fine.

ideas.idea: Fix the missing /img/loaves.jpg and add width/height attributes
ideas.why: The referenced image file isn't in the repo, so the page has a broken image.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card tags
ideas.why: This applies to almost any site and mainly affects social previews.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap
ideas.why: This is a standard sitemap improvement with modest effect on a 3-URL site.

ideas.idea: Remove the robots.txt Disallow for /members/ so the noindex is read
ideas.why: The report's own deliberate-choices list says noindex plus disallow on /members is correct for a private page.

ideas.idea: Add a footer, a contact or location page, and breadcrumbs
ideas.why: This is generic navigation advice, and breadcrumbs add little on a 4-page site.

ideas.idea: Make the home and breads meta descriptions more specific
ideas.why: The descriptions are already accurate, so the effect of rewording them is small.
The deliberate choices say having no llms.txt is not a problem, and it is folklore as a way to be found.

ideas.idea: Add a favicon, custom 404 page and hreflang/alternate links
ideas.why: This is boilerplate advice that applies to nearly any site, and hreflang isn't needed for a single-language site.

ideas.idea: Keep geo.config.json in sync with robots.txt
ideas.why: This is a reasonable maintenance reminder but is not a concrete change to the site.
